extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for devising, organizing, and refining stand-up comedy material (especially list bits and densely worded routines) following George Carlin's method.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capture every observation/idea immediately
rubrics_metrics.description: Capture every observation/idea immediately, however raw.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Carlin kept 1,400+ files over 44 years and paper scraps with words and phrases. The point is to record thoughts the moment they occur so nothing is lost.

rubrics_metrics.name: File by topic / category
rubrics_metrics.description: File material by topic or category.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sort paper scraps and digital notes into topical categories so related ideas are grouped and retrievable later.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cross-reference categories to find unexpected combinations
rubrics_metrics.description: Cross-reference categories to combine independent ideas into larger routines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Link ideas across files and topics to discover surprising juxtapositions and richer material — a key step in building larger bits from smaller notions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Generate way more material than needed
rubrics_metrics.description: Generate far more candidates than the final bit requires.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For list routines Carlin would write 40–50 candidates to arrive at 25 strong items. Quantity gives choices to select and refine the best material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refine via repeated performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Refine material through repeated live performance and feedback.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Every line was reworked many times; material evolved on stage and improved with audience response — use performance as an iterative testing ground.

rubrics_metrics.name: Don't be precious — ruthlessly cut
rubrics_metrics.description: Be willing to cut material ruthlessly; don't cling to lines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Trimming and ruthless editing are essential. Even favorite lines may need to go if they don't serve the bit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Density of word-play
rubrics_metrics.description: Use a high density of word-play: pile up jargon, clichés, and buzzwords.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The 'Modern Man' routine demonstrates packing jargon and clichés to create momentum; self-aware corporate/marketing language can be used ironically to build texture and comedy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rhythmic use of clichés and jargon
rubrics_metrics.description: Stringing clichés creates rhythm and absurdity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Arrange repeated or similar phrases to create a musical cadence; the accumulation itself can become the joke by exposing the ridiculousness of the language.

rubrics_metrics.name: List-routine craft and overproduction
rubrics_metrics.description: For list bits, overproduce candidate items and iteratively refine to a smaller, stronger set.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Carlin's practice: write many candidates, then refine the surviving items through repeated edits and performances until the list is tight and powerful.

rubrics_metrics.name: Every line must be reworked many times
rubrics_metrics.description: Each line should be repeatedly revised.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Line-level tinkering — wording, rhythm, placement — is crucial. Expect to rewrite lines multiple times based on how they land in performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Thematic focus (choice of themes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Select themes that align with the comic's voice: language abuse, hypocrisy of authority, bodily embarrassments, classism and political power.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Carlin's strongest material tended to revolve around these topics; choosing a clear thematic focus helps unify bits and give them emotional/ideological weight.

rubrics_metrics.name: Is there a clear topical anger or wonderment driving the bit?
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluate whether the bit has a clear emotional driver (anger or wonderment).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A strong core emotion motivates the material and gives the bit direction and urgency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Is the language dense and rhythmic?
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess whether the language is packed and has a rhythmic flow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dense, rhythmic phrasing increases momentum and can amplify the comic effect when matched to performance timing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does the bit reveal hypocrisy or pretension?
rubrics_metrics.description: Check whether the bit exposes hypocrisy, pretension, or institutional nonsense.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bits that puncture authority or pretension often resonate strongly; look for angles that reveal imbalance or absurdity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Are clichés stripped to absurdity?
rubrics_metrics.description: Determine whether clichés are used and then subverted or reduced to absurdity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Using and then deflating clichés can expose how language conceals meaning and generate comedic surprise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Has the bit been refined through many iterations?
rubrics_metrics.description: Confirm that the bit has undergone many rounds of revision and performance testing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Longevity and polish come from continual refinement — if a bit hasn't been workshopped repeatedly, it's likely undercooked.
